themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential election defeat in Brazil, senior right-wing figures and allied international leaders have engaged in transnational coordination to manage the fallout. Senator Bolsonaro's flight to Florida with assistance from foreign networks, coupled with open backing from Donald Trump and tactical support from Argentina, underscores cross-border solidarity among right-wing populists facing electoral defeat.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for Florida following his election loss to Lula, triggering domestic legal inquiries and money laundering investigations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump declared Flávio Bolsonaro welcome to remain in the US indefinitely, while conservative operatives reportedly facilitated his transport.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's administration and intelligence officials faced political scrutiny over reported logistics assistance during Bolsonaro's transit.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple nations are highlighting aggressive judicial interventions, law enforcement actions, and state surveillance aimed at their movements. From violent political clashes surrounding Poland's Constitutional Tribunal to legal battles in France, Brazil, and the US, conservative leaders accuse ruling establishments of weaponizing legal institutions.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS-backed President Karol Nawrocki clashed with government forces over physical access and control of the Constitutional Tribunal.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen condemned the Polish government's actions as a forced judicial takeover while pursuing her own eligibility appeals in French high courts.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Federal judicial authorities enforced passport seizures and launched money laundering probes targeting the Bolsonaro family.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration launched federal lawsuits targeting state election rules while fighting state attorney general suits blocking executive projects.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing nationalist movements are reinforcing 'national priority' frames, demanding immediate cutbacks on migrant integration funding, strict deportations, and cultural assimilation. Factions across Spain, Germany, Sweden, and the UK insist domestic taxpayers and native culture must take precedence over international obligations.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demanded the return of unaccompanied migrant minors in regional budget pacts and denounced municipal funding increases for migrant reception centers.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Promoted mandatory low-wage work requirements for asylum seekers while capitalizing on public safety anxieties around migrant crime.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Party strategists debated 'open Swedishness' and demanded strict cultural integration as a prerequisite for national belonging.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Challenged municipal opponents over high immigration levels and campaigned to redirect local government spending away from foreign aid.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Leveraged voter migration and security concerns to attract disillusioned mainstream voters ahead of upcoming elections.

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist right parties are capitalizing on incumbent governance crises, infrastructure failures, and economic anxiety to build polling momentum ahead of crucial elections. Surges for Vox in Spain, Marine Le Pen in France, FrP in Norway, and MAGA mobilization in the US demonstrate a shared transnational wave of right-wing gains.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Polls project PP and Vox reaching an absolute legislative majority following widespread public dissatisfaction over regional rail disasters.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen recorded significant polling increases, pulling up to nearly a fifth of former Macron voters into her coalition.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and JD Vance intensified campaign rallies and targeted financial relief promises to solidify control ahead of midterm elections.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Achieved historic high poll ratings between 32% and 34%, asserting itself as Norway's premier conservative political force.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Sustained electoral pressure on mainstream parties through targeted local council by-elections and national campaign initiatives.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing coalitions and conservative parties are navigating significant internal discord regarding foreign policy commitments, strategic alliances, and public messaging. Contested stances on Ukraine military aid in Italy, ideological debates on cultural identity in Sweden, and tactical rivalries in Argentina point to growing friction within right-wing power structures.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini's anti-war and pro-Russia rhetoric directly clashed with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's pro-Ukraine international policy.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Internal ideological disagreements erupted over the party's cultural definitions and formal cooperation with mainstream coalition partners.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Strains deepened between Javier Milei's core advisors and cabinet allies over regional diplomatic ties and 2027 presidential ambitions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Internal fractures emerged over foreign military escalation threats in the Middle East and economic policy trade-offs.
